articles.title: OpenAI Releases GPT-5 Turbo with Native Multimodal Reasoning Across Code, Video, and Audio
articles.summary: OpenAI launched GPT-5 Turbo, featuring tightly integrated multimodal reasoning that can jointly process video streams, code repositories, and audio in a single context window of up to 1M tokens. Benchmarks show a 38% improvement on SWE-Bench Verified over GPT-4.5, with notably stronger performance on long-horizon agentic coding tasks. The model is available via API with a new streaming tool-use protocol designed for persistent agent deployments.

articles.title: Google DeepMind's Gemini Ultra 2 Achieves State-of-the-Art on Mathematical Olympiad Problems
articles.summary: DeepMind announced Gemini Ultra 2, which scored a gold-medal-equivalent 86% on a held-out set of International Mathematical Olympiad problems, surpassing previous AI systems by a significant margin. The model uses a novel chain-of-verification architecture that iteratively checks its own proof steps using a separate formal verifier module. Researchers say the approach generalizes well to graduate-level STEM reasoning and theorem proving in Lean 4.

articles.title: Figure Robotics Begins Commercial Deployment of Figure 03 Humanoids in BMW Manufacturing Lines
articles.summary: Figure AI confirmed that its third-generation humanoid robot, Figure 03, has entered series production deployment at two BMW assembly plants in South Carolina. The robots handle bin-picking, part inspection, and inter-station transport with a reported 99.2% task completion rate across 16-hour shifts. Figure says improved proprioceptive control and a transformer-based visuomotor policy trained on 50,000 hours of teleoperation data underpin the reliability gains over its predecessor.

articles.title: Tesla Optimus Gen 3 Demonstrates Autonomous Household Tasks in Live Public Demo
articles.summary: At a live event in Palo Alto, Tesla showcased Optimus Gen 3 performing unsupervised household routines including folding laundry, loading a dishwasher, and navigating cluttered rooms without pre-mapped environments. The robot uses an end-to-end vision-language-action model that accepts natural language instructions and plans multi-step manipulation sequences in real time. Tesla stated a limited consumer pilot program will begin in Q1 2027 priced at under $25,000.

articles.title: Anthropic Introduces Claude 'Computer Agent' Mode for Autonomous Enterprise Workflow Execution
articles.summary: Anthropic released a general-availability Computer Agent capability for Claude, enabling the model to autonomously operate desktop and web applications through pixel-level screen understanding and programmatic input control. Early enterprise customers report 60-70% reduction in manual back-office processing time for tasks such as invoice reconciliation and CRM data migration. The system includes a human-in-the-loop approval framework and comprehensive audit logging to meet SOC 2 compliance requirements.

articles.title: TSMC Begins Volume Production of 1.4nm A14 Process Node with Backside Power Delivery
articles.summary: TSMC announced volume production on its A14 (1.4nm-class) process node at its Fab 20 facility in Hsinchu, marking the industry's first sub-1.5nm commercial chipmaking process. The node integrates backside power delivery network (BSPDN) and gate-all-around nanosheet transistors, delivering roughly 20% higher performance and 30% lower power versus N2. First customer chips are expected to be AI accelerator and mobile SoC designs from Apple and NVIDIA taping out in late 2026.

articles.title: Neuralink Receives FDA Clearance for Second-Generation Brain-Computer Interface Implant
articles.summary: The FDA granted De Novo clearance to Neuralink's N2 implant, a second-generation BCI device with 4,096 electrodes — 4x the channel count of its first-generation device — and fully wireless bidirectional data transfer at over 200 Mbps. Clinical trial results from 12 participants with spinal cord injuries showed cursor control latencies under 50ms and preliminary handwriting-via-thought speeds approaching 90 characters per minute. Neuralink plans to expand its trial to 50 additional participants across five U.S. medical centers.

articles.title: Meta Open-Sources Llama 4 Behemoth 700B with Mixture-of-Experts and On-Device Distillation Toolkit
articles.summary: Meta released Llama 4 Behemoth, a 700B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with 128 experts and 16 active per token, under a permissive open license. Alongside the model, Meta published a distillation toolkit that enables developers to compress task-specific expert subsets down to models small enough to run on mobile NPUs with minimal quality degradation. The release is widely seen as an inflection point for on-device generative AI, lowering the barrier for privacy-preserving, latency-sensitive applications.
